description: Change a Campaign (a named workstream inside a Space). For reads prefer list_campaigns and get_campaign. Actions: open (name, optional purpose); park (reason) to pause; resume; propose_close (outcome_draft); close, approved by a different principal, or confirmed by the proposer with confirm=true when only one active principal remains; reassign_owner (to; default you) when the owner seat is revoked or you own it. Action get needs campaign_id. Close also writes an Articles receipt. Writes need write scope; not idempotent.

action.description: One of open, park, resume, propose_close, close, reassign_owner, list, get.

campaign_id.description: Campaign (a named workstream in this Space) to use; omit for the Space's default Campaign. Ids come from list_campaigns.

confirm.description: close: true as the second step when you are the only active principal.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A string you generate once per intended action (a UUID is good) and repeat on retry. A retry with the same key and arguments returns the first result instead of acting twice; the same key with different arguments is refused. Kept 24 hours.

outcome_draft.description: propose_close: the outcome text to record.

purpose.description: One or two sentences on what this is for. Shown to everyone invited.

to.description: reassign_owner: new owner seat_id; default you.

name: campaign
title: Campaign
